en.title: One killed, four injured in Washington D.C. gym shooting
en.dek: Police report one dead and four hurt after shooting at Logan Circle gym
facts: One person killed and four injured in mass shooting at DC gym
Shooting occurred at gym in Logan Circle neighborhood
Suspect barricaded himself in building after shooting
Suspect apprehended after self-inflicted gunshot wound
body: Police reported one person was killed and four were injured in a mass shooting at a gym in DC's Logan Circle according to mycbs4.com and WJLA.
The gunman first shot and killed a person in a gym, then continued firing after reaching the street. According to police, he then barricaded himself in a building.
Authorities say the suspected shooter has been apprehended, after he shot himself, as reported by Euronews.
The Advocate.com reported the shooting occurred at VIDA Fitness, a gay-owned gym in D.C., leaving one dead and the suspect barricaded.
Multiple outlets confirmed the incident including mycbs4.com and WJLA.
Police confirmed casualties but no suspect description provided in initial reports.
The incident marks another shooting at a public venue in the nation's capital.
Details regarding the motive remain under investigation by authorities.
en.context: A shooting at a gym in Washington D.C.'s Logan Circle neighborhood resulted in one death and four injuries, as confirmed by multiple news outlets reporting on the incident.

Authorities responded to the scene but have not released information about a suspect or motive as of the initial reports.

en.headline: Gunman kills one and barricades himself in building after gym shooting
en.body: The gunman first shot and killed a person in a gym, then continued firing after reaching the street. According to police, he then barricaded himself in a building. Authorities say the suspected shooter has been apprehended, after he shot himself.

de.headline: Schütze tötet einen und barrikadiert sich in Gebäude nach Schießerei im Fitnessstudio
de.body: Der Schütze tötete zunächst eine Person im Fitnessstudio und setzte das Feuer auf der Straße fort. Anschließend barrikadierte er sich in einem Gebäude. Behörden gaben bekannt, dass der mutmaßliche Täter festgenommen wurde, nachdem er sich selbst geschossen hatte.

es.headline: Gunman mata a una persona y se encierra en un edificio tras tiroteo en un gimnasio
es.body: El agresor disparó y mató a una persona en un gimnasio, continuó disparando tras llegar a la calle. Según la policía, se barricadió luego en un edificio. Las autoridades informan que el sospechoso fue detenido tras dispararse.

fr.headline: Un tireur tue une personne et se barricade dans un bâtiment après une fusillade en salle de sport
fr.body: Le tireur a d'abord abattu une personne dans une salle de sport, puis a continué à tirer en rejoignant la rue. Selon la police, il s'est ensuite barricadé dans un bâtiment. Les autorités ont indiqué que le tireur présumé a été interpellé après s'être tiré une balle.

it.headline: Uomo armato uccide una persona e si barrica in un edificio dopo una sparatoria in palestra
it.body: L'uomo ha prima sparato e ucciso una persona in una palestra, poi ha continuato a sparare dopo essere sceso in strada. Secondo la polizia, si è poi barricato in un edificio. Le autorità hanno dichiarato che il sospetto autore è stato arrestato dopo essersi ferito.

pt.headline: Atirador mata uma pessoa e barrica-se em edifício após tiroteio em ginásio
pt.body: O atirador disparou primeiro e matou uma pessoa num ginásio, tendo continuado a disparar ao chegar à rua. Segundo a polícia, barricou-se depois num edifício. As autoridades afirmam que o atirador suspeito foi detido, depois de se ter baleado.

zh.headline: 枪手在健身房行凶致一人死亡后与警方对峙
zh.body: 该枪手先是在一家健身房内开枪打死一人，随后在街头继续射击。据警方称，他随后躲入一栋建筑物内与警方对峙。当局表示，嫌疑人在开枪自伤后已被逮捕。

ko.headline: 체육관 총격 사건으로 1명 사망 후 건물에 고립된 총격범 체포
ko.body: 총격범은 먼저 체육관에서 사람을 쏘아 사망하게 한 후 거리로 나와 계속 발포했습니다. 경찰에 따르면 그는 이후 건물에 스스로를 고립시켰습니다. 당국은 용의자가 스스로 총을 쏘아 사망한 후 체포되었다고 밝혔습니다.

ja.headline: ジムで銃撃、1人死亡　男は建物に立てこもり
ja.body: 男はまずジムで1人を射殺し、路上に出た後も発砲を続けた。警察によると、男はその後、建物に立てこもった。当局は、容疑者の男が自ら銃で撃った後、身柄を確保されたと発表した。
